data.title: Bitcoin, XRP, Ethereum, and Solana Drop. Will Crypto Recover by the End of 2026?
data.description: Bitcoin is already down 29% and leading the pack, while Ethereum, Solana, and XRP have fallen even harder. Two specific conditions have to flip before any recovery can start, and the clock is running out.
data.keywords: XRP, Solana, Bitcoin price, Ethereum, Interest rates
